name: @activepieces/piece-qdrant
description: Make any action on your qdrant vector database

auth.description:
### Using Qdrant cloud
1. Connect to your [Qdrant cloud account](https://cloud.qdrant.io)
2. Create a new cluster if it's the first time you  use Qdrant
3. Go to Data Access Control and create a new api key and copy it
4. Go to clusters, click on the arrow `>` and copy the Cluster URL.

### Using self-hosted Qdrant
Try to create your own qdrant instance using the [documentation guides](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/guides/)

serverAddress.description: The url of the Qdrant instance.

key.description: Enter the API Key of your Qdrant account

add_points_to_collection.name: add_points_to_collection
add_points_to_collection.description: Insert a point (= embedding or vector + other infos) to a specific collection, if the collection does not exist it will be created

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

embeddingsIds.description: The ids of the embeddings for the points. If not provided, the ids will be generated automatically

distance.description: The calculation method helps to rank vectors when you want to find the closest points, the method to use depends on the model who's created the embeddings, see the documentation of your model

payload.description: Please follow [payload documentation](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/concepts/payload/) to add additional information to the points.

storage.description: Define where points will be stored

aiMetadata.description: Upsert one or more points (vectors plus optional payload) into a Qdrant collection, auto-creating the collection with the chosen distance metric if it does not yet exist. Use to load embeddings into a vector store. Embeddings are passed as a file and must all share the same dimensionality. Not idempotent: when point ids are omitted they are randomly generated, so each call appends new points; supply stable ids to overwrite the same points instead.

collection_list.name: collection_list
collection_list.description: Get the list of all the collections of your database

aiMetadata.description: List all collections in the connected Qdrant instance. Use to discover available collection names before targeting one with another action. Takes no input. Read-only and idempotent.

collection_infos.name: collection_infos
collection_infos.description: Get the all the infos of a specific collection

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve configuration and status details for a single Qdrant collection by name (vector params, point counts, indexing state, etc.). Use to inspect a collection before reading from or writing to it. Read-only and idempotent.

delete_collection.name: delete_collection
delete_collection.description: Delete a collection of your database

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete an entire Qdrant collection, including all of its points, identified by collection name. Use to tear down a vector store. Idempotent: re-running once the collection is gone leaves the same end state.

delete_points.name: delete_points
delete_points.description: Delete points of a specific collection

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

getPointsBy.description: The method to use to get the points

aiMetadata.description: Delete points from a Qdrant collection, selecting them either by an explicit list of ids or by a payload filter (must / must_not conditions). Use to remove specific vectors from a collection. Idempotent: deleting points that are already absent leaves the same end state.

get_points.name: get_points
get_points.description: Get the points of a specific collection

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

getPointsBy.description: The method to use to get the points

aiMetadata.description: Fetch points from a Qdrant collection, selecting them either by an explicit list of ids or by a payload filter (must / must_not conditions). Use to look up known points or scroll through points matching metadata, as opposed to vector-similarity search. Read-only and idempotent.

search_points.name: search_points
search_points.description: Search for points closest to your given vector (= embedding)

collectionName.description: The name of the collection needed for this action

vector.description: The vector (= embedding) you want to search for.

must.description: If the point have this property in his payload it will be selected

must_not.description: If the point have this property in his payload it will not be selected

negativeVector.description: The vector (= embedding) you want to be the farthest.

limitResult.description: The max number of results you want to get.

aiMetadata.description: Run a vector-similarity search against a Qdrant collection, returning the points nearest to a supplied query embedding, optionally narrowed by a payload filter and steered away from an optional negative vector. Use this for semantic / nearest-neighbor retrieval; use Get Points instead when selecting by id or metadata only. The query vector is passed as a file and must match the collection dimensionality. Read-only and idempotent.

nl.\n### Using Qdrant cloud\n1. Connect to:
### Gebruik van Qdrant cloud
1. Verbind met je [Qdrant cloud account](https://cloud.qdrant.io)
2. Creëer een nieuw cluster als het de eerste keer is dat u Qdrant
3 gebruikt. Ga naar Data Access Control en maak een nieuwe API key en kopieer deze
4. Ga naar clusters, klik op de pijl `>` en kopieer de Cluster URL.

### Maak gebruik van zelfgehoste Qdrant
Probeer je eigen qdrant instantie te maken met behulp van de [documentatiehandleidingen](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/guides/)

de.\n### Using Qdrant cloud\n1. Connect to:
### Mit Qdrant Cloud
1. Verbinden Sie sich mit Ihrem [Qdrant Cloud Konto](https://cloud.qdrant.io)
2. Erstellen Sie einen neuen Cluster, wenn es das erste Mal ist, dass Sie Qdrant
3 verwenden. Gehen Sie zur Data Access Control und erstellen Sie einen neuen Api Key und kopieren Sie ihn
4. Gehe zu Clustern, klicke auf den Pfeil `>` und kopiere die Cluster-URL.

### Verwendung von selbst gehostetem Qdrant
Versuche deine eigene Qdrant Instanz mithilfe der [Dokumentationsanleitung](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/guides/)
 zu erstellen

de.The calculation method helps to rank vec: Die Berechnungsmethode hilft Vektoren zu platzieren, wenn Sie die nächsten Punkte finden möchten die zu verwendende Methode hängt von dem Modell ab, der die Einbettungen erstellt hat, lesen Sie die Dokumentation Ihres Modells

Wenn der Punkt dieses Objekt in seiner Nutzlast hat, wird es nicht ausgewählt
de.The vector (= embedding) you want to be: Der Vektor (= Einbetten), den Sie am weitesten wollen.
de.The max number of results you want to ge: Die maximale Anzahl an Ergebnissen, die Sie erhalten möchten.

Essayez de créer votre propre instance qdrant à l'aide des [guides de documentation](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/guides/)
